title: robust-fair-ev-siting: code for 'Efficient plans dodge, fair plans hedge: forecast uncertainty and the robust fairness premium in electric vehicle charging siting'
description: Code to reproduce the forecasts, zone-wise conformal radii, robust and fair charging-siting models, permutation tests, feeder-constrained fairness ceilings and figures of the accompanying article. No data are included; the public UrbanEV and CHARGED datasets are downloaded from their original repositories by scripts/download_data.sh.
